notes.boxes: The internal YOLOv5 Detections object is not exported. Above-threshold boxes and class/confidence labels are drawn on frames before JPEG saving.
notes.threshold: The author script applies conf > conf_thres to results already filtered by the model. CLI conf_thres defaults to 0.5.
notes.coverage: Real checkpoint/video probe observed the without_object branch only. The with_object branch and naming are established by pinned source inspection.
notes.interoperability: No machine-readable bounding-box table or JSON is saved by this workflow.
